target_and_action: Described as a T-type calcium channel blocker (the Wwox paper's Methods wording; attribution by citation, no channel measured in Wwox tissue). The catalogue mechanism record lists T-type block only; the source paper's own oocyte data show a GIRK block at exposures near the labelled band (prior knowledge, not checked in the files).
context_of_the_measurement: Mouse, Wwox-null preweaning pups, PTZ-provoked seizure score, late phase. One acute experiment, n 6 and 6 for null PTZ-alone and drug; significant in the null genotype only, not significant in wild type and heterozygote; one PTZ dose for all genotypes; ANOVA only, no drug-by-genotype interaction term.
selectivity_limits: Millimolar T-current potency (persistent-current IC50 about 0.6 mM in stably transfected cells) against a labelled human plasma range of about 280 to 700 uM (as quoted in the worm paper); GIRK and other non-T-type actions reported; in a worm PTZ model protection persisted in a cca-1 loss-of-function double mutant (one concentration, n 13-15, no equivalence test).
exposure_or_development_note: Mouse pup level not measured in the figure 7b experiment; wild-type response decays to a floor, so a drug effect in wild type could be hidden.
what_it_separates: Whether the late-phase provoked-seizure score falls in the null (functional result); with a second, mechanistically different agent and an interaction term it would separate a Cav3-dependent effect from a non-selective drug effect (questions Q3, designed in the T-type package).
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate T-type from GIRK or other actions; does not give an isoform; does not establish genotype dependence (no interaction test, floor-limited wild type); the result is not to be transferred to Z944.

target_and_action: Non-selective GSK3 inhibitor (see INV-09); in this investigation a drug comparator in the same Wwox-null paper. No T-type action stated.
context_of_the_measurement: Mouse, Wwox-null, heterozygote and wild-type preweaning pups, PTZ-provoked seizure score; the lithium effect is present in all three genotypes; no head-to-head arm with ethosuximide (audit reading of figures 7b and 7d); the authors write that its efficacy is better than ethosuximide.
selectivity_limits: Lithium acts in wild type as in the null, so a drug effect in a seizing animal is not a WWOX-specific rescue; second action (inositol monophosphatase inhibition) with a documented pro-convulsant sign in rodents by analogy (abstract-level reading, not measured in the Wwox assay).
what_it_separates: Shows that a seizure-score reduction can occur in all genotypes with an agent that is not a T-type blocker, so reduction alone is not genotype-specific.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate T-type from GSK3 action; no interaction test; not a WWOX-specific rescue.

target_and_action: Cav3 (T-type) calcium channel blocker; Cav3 class only.
context_of_the_measurement: Human Cav3.2 in HEK293T, whole-cell patch clamp, room temperature, external calcium 10 or 20 mM, internal NMDG/EGTA; Cav3.2 IC50 about 265 nM (ML218 about 24 nM in the same experiment). No Wwox preparation.
selectivity_limits: Cav3.1 and Cav3.3 values not obtained; Cav1.4 IC50 about 31 uM; Cav1.2 and Cav2.2 about 70 to 100-fold above Cav3 (cited in the paper); shares the piperidine-amide scaffold with ML218 and TTA-P2 (shared pocket), so agreement between them does not rule out a shared off-target; no source read separates the isoforms.
exposure_or_development_note: No brain or plasma level in the sources read; no pup data anywhere in the package.
what_it_separates: A Cav3-class comparator for the provoked-seizure score beside ethosuximide, in the same design (the T-type package calls it the cleaner Cav3-class tool).
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate Cav3.1, 3.2 and 3.3; the ethosuximide result is not transferable to Z944; no drug-by-genotype datum.

comparator: efonidipine (first-named of the proposed pair; order-based reading)
target_and_action: Proposed T-type agent to verify; also acts on L-type channels or on receptors beyond the channel family (the ranking row states this for the two agents without assigning it).
context_of_the_measurement: NOT_IN_FILES
selectivity_limits: In the catalogue both agents are tagged selectivity Not Determined; one T-type target row for the first-named agent, three for the second-named (annotation completeness, not documented functional selectivity); no fitted potency on the three isoforms is carried for the first-named agent (ChEMBL holds no calcium-channel activity for it); absence of a subtype in a catalogue is not inactivity.
exposure_or_development_note: Not measured; potency in one assay and species, at the concentration reached in the animal, is the first step.
what_it_separates: Whether the pair differs in isoform reach, if potency on the three isoforms is first qualified in one assay and species and the pair is run beside the carded agent in the provoked-seizure design with an interaction term.
what_it_does_not_separate: The pair is a proposal to verify, not a documented discriminating pair; the same effect from two compounds is compatible with a common T-type target and does not by itself discriminate isoforms.

comparator: flunarizine (second-named of the proposed pair; order-based reading)
target_and_action: Proposed T-type agent to verify; also acts on L-type channels or on receptors beyond the channel family (the ranking row states this for the two agents without assigning it).
context_of_the_measurement: Catalogue: Kd values on all three T-type isoforms, only from synthesis papers that used it as a reference, in different assays and conditions (as stated for the second-named agent).
selectivity_limits: Tagged selectivity Not Determined in the catalogue; three T-type target rows are annotation completeness, not documented functional selectivity.
what_it_separates: As for the first-named agent: a possible isoform-reach difference, to be qualified in one assay before use.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not by itself discriminate isoforms; not a documented discriminating pair.

target_and_action: Cav3 blocker, structural analog of Z944; intended as a second chemotype.
context_of_the_measurement: Human Cav3.2 in HEK293T, identical conditions to Z944; Cav3.2 IC50 about 24 nM, about 10-fold more potent than Z944 in the same cells.
selectivity_limits: Cav1.4 IC50 about 2 uM (DHP-like, with partial agonist effect), Cav1.2 about 37 uM; window to Cav3.2 about 89-fold (derived from Table 2); fails in Parkinsonian monkeys per the paper's introduction; Cav3.1 and Cav3.3 not in the sources read.
what_it_separates: Intended: a second Cav3 blocker for class-level agreement.
what_it_does_not_separate: A 'second chemotype' only in name: Z944, ML218 and TTA-P2 share the piperidine-amide scaffold, so agreement does not rule out a shared off-target; no isoform resolution.

target_and_action: Cav3 blocker of the same scaffold family; binds in the II-III fenestration with a dichlorobenzamide head like ML218 (cryo-EM complex with Cav3.2).
context_of_the_measurement: Cryo-EM complex with Cav3.2; potency in HEK293T patch clamp, values in Supplementary tables not read.
selectivity_limits: Same scaffold family as ML218 and Z944; not resolved here for isoforms.
what_it_separates: Included only to show the class has structural analogs; not proposed as a first probe.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not give an independent chemotype or an isoform.

comparator: genetic perturbation (Cacna1g, Cacna1h or Cacna1i loss)
target_and_action: Loss of one T-type alpha-1 subunit gene; isoform-resolving by construction.
context_of_the_measurement: Not applicable; only the existing IT28 R5 occlusion design is available.
selectivity_limits: Developmental compensation; loss of the margin to see a further benefit.
what_it_separates: Which isoform, if any, carries the effect (by construction).
what_it_does_not_separate: Not proposed as the first comparison; no Wwox-tissue datum (Cacna1g/h transcripts in P17 null deposits fall within the control-line background).

target_and_action: Glutamate-site competitive NMDAR antagonist; competitive and surmountable, so occupancy falls when glutamate rises in a burst.
context_of_the_measurement: Wwox neuron-knockout (Synapsin-Cre) neocortical slices, layer II/III, postnatal day 13 to 17: bursts eliminated at 50 micromolar (51 bursts, 5 slices, 3 animals; no significance marker in the printed figure; the burst baseline is printed twice with different values).
selectivity_limits: Mild subunit preference (rat Ki about 0.14x and 0.6x, mildly GluN2A-preferring, compiled ChEMBL grading); the recording bath magnesium is not stated.
exposure_or_development_note: Tool compound; no human exposure found in earlier notes; no free-exposure value collected.
what_it_separates: In the planned X2: a matched measured fractional reduction of the isolated NMDAR EPSC by d-APV against a GluN2B NAM titration, so burst suppression needing GluN2B-containing current is told from any matched reduction of total NMDAR current.
what_it_does_not_separate: Full competitive block is not a partial block; cannot identify the defect or the subunit; compatible with gain, permissive necessity and AMPAR-led drive; AMPAR contribution untested.

target_and_action: GluN2B negative allosteric modulator (ifenprodil site), tool compound.
context_of_the_measurement: Compiled oocyte values 9 nM (GluN2B) versus 52,000 nM (GluN2A) from a review of Fischer 1997 (NR1C clones; species not stated at abstract level); conditions of the primary paper unread.
selectivity_limits: Window of 10^2 to 10^3 is a cross-paper compilation, not one experiment; other actions not verified here. [IT40b] Maximum and conditions of the primary paper remain unread (abstract level).
what_it_separates: One of two NAMs of the same ifenprodil site; the pair controls chemotype only, not site or ceiling (tool before clinical compound).
what_it_does_not_separate: A steeper burst fall alone is not evidence of subunit specificity; a GluN2B NAM effect shows participation of GluN2B-containing receptors, not that the lesion lies in GluN2B. [IT40b] It does not separate a GluN2A pool from an insensitive triheteromer pool.

target_and_action: GluN2B NAM (ifenprodil site).
context_of_the_measurement: Oocyte set-up with 100 micromolar glutamate and glycine, pH 7.3, -60 mV: 155 nM (GluN2B) and 28 micromolar (GluN2A), about 180-fold; compiled Hess 1996: 110 versus 39,500 nM; native cortical neuron high-affinity IC50 0.21 micromolar (WO-12).
selectivity_limits: Inhibition incomplete and pH and agonist-level dependent; sigma and alpha-1 actions are prior knowledge, UNVERIFIED in the earlier packages. [IT40b] Primary values (oocytes, -40 mV, 100 uM glutamate plus 50 uM glycine; 24607230, partial full text): GluN2B IC50 72 nM, maximum 88 percent; GluN2A unchanged at 3 uM; triheteromer IC50 450 nM, maximum 32 percent, 50 percent with 300 nM Zn2+.
what_it_separates: A second NAM of the same ifenprodil site controls chemotype only (same site, same triheteromer ceiling).
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not give subunit specificity of the burst effect on its own; incomplete inhibition means the maximal NAM effect is below a full block. [IT40b] It does not separate a GluN2A pool from an insensitive triheteromer pool.

target_and_action: GluN2B NAM, clinical-stage compound.
context_of_the_measurement: In vitro: GluN2B complexes only (IC50 about 4 to 70 nM across assays; mouse GluN2B 3.2 nM). In vivo: reduced onset and severity of audiogenic seizures dose-dependently in mice homozygous for a GluN2A gain-of-function change (abstract), more in females; age not stated in the abstract; methods not reachable.
selectivity_limits: GluN2A potency not retrievable; whether the mutant receptors are GluN2A/GluN2B assemblies is not in the abstract; other actions not collected; susceptibility itself differs by sex. [IT40b] Species matter: rat GluN1/GluN2B maximum 82 percent against rat triheteromer 45 percent (human GluN1/GluN2B 91 percent); the oocyte bath held 10 uM EDTA (40994429 Table 1).
exposure_or_development_note: Human exposure exists in earlier notes (adults, three infants, registered paediatric studies); no free brain exposure value collected here; reflex seizures, not chronic control and not development.
what_it_separates: That a GluN2B-directed lever worked where the lesion sits in GluN2A: efficacy separates 'circuit lever' from 'subunit that carries the lesion'.
what_it_does_not_separate: Efficacy in a GluN2A-lesioned line shows the lever, not the lesion; no WWOX model with an NMDAR modulator was identified; it does not separate GluN2B participation from a matched-current reduction.

target_and_action: Uncompetitive open-channel pore blocker, fast off-rate; the ChEMBL 'negative allosteric modulator' label is vocabulary, not site.
context_of_the_measurement: Autaptic rat hippocampal neurons, day 13 in vitro, room temperature: 1 micromolar blocked 27.1% (synaptic) and 50.4% (extrasynaptic, bath NMDA) of the current, ratio 1.94 +/- 0.10 (n = 24); 10 micromolar with 1 mM Mg2+ at -25 mV: 39.8% and 64.3%. A later culture paper (abstract) found memantine and ketamine indistinguishable on synaptic and extrasynaptic inhibition. Not tested in any WWOX preparation.
selectivity_limits: Little NR2-subunit preference; Mg2+ and Ca2+ dependence; preference is two-fold, not exclusion; the 'extrasynaptic' current is sustained high agonist, not tonic ambient glutamate; other targets not collected.
exposure_or_development_note: Nominal bath concentrations only; free reachable concentration in the WWOX preparation is not established; the minutes-scale activation premise differs from the burst duration (median 0.66 s per Supplementary Table S1).
what_it_separates: Memantine is the clinically used pore-blocker comparator for the burst outcome, to be run second-line after the GluN2B NAM versus matched-current d-APV comparison, with Mg2+ and voltage stated.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate subunits (pore blocker); pore-blocker properties are not transferable across blockers (MK-801 differs); not an informative pair with ketamine for physiology.

target_and_action: Uncompetitive pore blocker.
context_of_the_measurement: Abstract level only: indistinguishable from memantine on steady-state current, EPSC decay, repetitive inhibition and extrasynaptic inhibition at equimolar concentration; more neuroprotective under oxygen-glucose deprivation; the spontaneous network measures were in dissociated culture. A single infant case of status epilepticus is reported (partial response to ketamine, seizure-free once memantine was added).
selectivity_limits: Other actions not collected here.
what_it_separates: Removes the basis for treating memantine and ketamine as a contrast.
what_it_does_not_separate: Memantine plus ketamine is not an informative pair for physiology; not a subunit contrast; the case cannot separate concomitant ketamine, timing and spontaneous termination.

target_and_action: Uncompetitive pore blocker, trapping, slow off-rate.
context_of_the_measurement: Autaptic neurons (same paper as memantine): about 94% block of synaptic and about 96% of extrasynaptic current at 1 micromolar; ratio 1.02 (93.6 +/- 0.5% and 95.7 +/- 0.9%).
selectivity_limits: Same class label as memantine, different behaviour: properties are not transferable across pore blockers.
what_it_separates: A within-class contrast: a pore blocker with equal synaptic and extrasynaptic block against memantine's 1.94 ratio in the same paper.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not address a WWOX preparation or subunit contrast.

target_and_action: Mg2+-competitive, not ATP- or substrate-competitive (IT15 abstract-level source, carried); pooled inhibitor of GSK3.
context_of_the_measurement: Mouse Wwox-null, heterozygote and wild-type preweaning pups, PTZ-provoked seizure score: lowered in all genotypes (reused R02). Kinase panel with LiCl at a millimolar level (radioactive filter assay, ATP near Km): GSK3 beta inhibited most strongly, but MNK1, MNK2, smMLCK, PHK, CHK2, HIPK3, IKKepsilon, TBK1 with slightly lower potency; alpha not measured.
selectivity_limits: Non-kinase actions (inositol monophosphatase named in IT15); a lithium effect is not by itself GSK3 dependence; opposes the Wnt need (stabilises beta-catenin).
what_it_separates: Reference arm: the only pharmacology of the thread; beside a dual or isoform-selective inhibitor at matched target engagement, and repeated after GSK3A and GSK3B knock-down, it would separate lithium action from GSK3 dependence.
what_it_does_not_separate: Not tested in a GSK3-deleted background; no second GSK3 inhibitor in a Wwox-null system; the Wwox-null effect is also present in wild type.

target_and_action: ATP-site aminopyrimidine GSK3 inhibitor; treated as dual alpha/beta.
context_of_the_measurement: Panel of 70 to 80 kinases at 1 micromolar (low ATP, GSK3 beta): CDK2-cyclin A about 50-fold weaker, nothing else significant; 1 to 2 micromolar reported to abolish NDRG1 and c-Jun Thr239 phosphorylation (cited, not read); in HEK293T it raised total and nuclear beta-catenin and the TCF/LEF reporter. It lowers NMDAR current in control neurons (E12, rat organotypic work).
selectivity_limits: Panel has no GSK3 alpha; same-document ChEMBL ratio about 1.6 alpha:beta (carried by identifier); kinase-only panel; non-kinase targets not covered; beta-catenin stabilisation is a built-in readout of dual action. Audit: 'two sources' is one source cited twice; the panel cannot show duality.
what_it_separates: A selective ATP-site comparator beside the non-selective lithium in the same assay.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate alpha from beta; any burst reduction may be plain NMDAR current reduction; the PI4KIIalpha paper's attribution to beta rests on this compound alone.

target_and_action: ATP-site pyrazolo-tetrahydroquinolinone, GSK3 alpha-preferring.
context_of_the_measurement: 311 kinases at 10 micromolar (outside laboratory panel): next most potent CDK2, CDK3, CDK5 at 87- to 123-fold weaker than GSK3 alpha; biochemical alpha IC50 66 nM, beta 515 nM (about 8-fold, mobility shift, Km ATP); live-cell NanoBRET Kd 4.8 micromolar in HEK293 (window more than 4- to 6-fold); GSK3 alpha Tyr279 down, Tyr216 not, in leukemia lines; GSK3A-knockout U937 clones showed no added effect.
selectivity_limits: Selectivity erodes toward the cellular Kd; beta-catenin rise only at high micromolar levels (reporter induction at 60 uM; total beta-catenin protein largely below dual-inhibitor levels up to 80 uM, audit); CDK family at about 100-fold margin; substrate selectivity not tested.
what_it_separates: Alpha versus beta, as a matched pair with BRD3731 and the inactive enantiomer BRD5648, plus isoform knock-down in the same neurons.
what_it_does_not_separate: No WWOX or neuronal datum; the 8-fold biochemical window shrinks to 4- to 6-fold in cells; does not separate substrate branches.

target_and_action: ATP-site, GSK3 beta-preferring (same scaffold as BRD0705).
context_of_the_measurement: Same 311-kinase panel (selectivity stated exquisite); biochemical beta 15 nM, alpha 215 nM (about 14-fold); cell window more than 4- to 6-fold, Kd 3.3 micromolar; raised beta-catenin from 20 micromolar in HL-60 and TF-1, not in MV4-11 or the murine leukemia model.
selectivity_limits: Beta-catenin stabilisation is context dependent; substrate selectivity not tested.
what_it_separates: Partner of BRD0705 for a matched alpha/beta pair.
what_it_does_not_separate: No structural inactive control for BRD3731 (the enantiomer control is for BRD0705 only, audit); no WWOX or neuronal datum.

target_and_action: Inactive enantiomer of BRD0705, relatively inactive against GSK3s (paper statement).
context_of_the_measurement: Leukemia cells: no change in phosphorylation or beta-catenin.
selectivity_limits: None reported.
what_it_separates: Matched negative control for the BRD0705 pair: separates a GSK3 effect from a scaffold effect.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not control for BRD3731.

target_and_action: ATP-competitive GSK3 inhibitor (as stated by McManus 2005). Listed in the probes; not proposed as an arm.
context_of_the_measurement: Ex vivo muscle only: raised glycogen synthase activity about five-fold in wild-type and S21A/S9A muscle.
selectivity_limits: Bain: apart from AR-A014418, the other four GSK3 inhibitors inhibited several kinases besides CDK2-cyclin A; the AR-A014418 values themselves were not read; alpha and beta not measured separately in the sources read.
what_it_separates: Evidence that the S9A/S21A enzyme remains inhibitable by an ATP-site compound (a metabolic functional readout in muscle, not a neuronal or WWOX outcome).
what_it_does_not_separate: No WWOX, seizure or neuronal outcome; role assignment is the nearest fit, not a stated purpose.

target_and_action: Bisarylmaleimide, ATP-site GSK3 inhibitor. Listed because it is the compound in the Foxg1 oligodendroglial precedent; not an arm here.
context_of_the_measurement: Oligodendroglial precedent (reused R05); kinase panel in Bain.
selectivity_limits: Panel: inhibited ERK8, DYRK1A, PIM3, SRPK1, HIPK2; isoforms not measured; substrate not tested.
what_it_separates: Functional precedent for a GSK3 compound on oligodendrocyte differentiation (sign of GSK3 effect on differentiation divided, R05/R06).
what_it_does_not_separate: No WWOX or seizure datum; role assignment is the nearest fit, not a stated purpose.

target_and_action: shRNA or isogenic knockout of one or both GSK3 isoforms.
context_of_the_measurement: Embryonic stem cell literature cited: single loss does not raise beta-catenin; knockout clones used as target-dependence control (E24).
selectivity_limits: Compensation by the other isoform; double GSK3A/B depletion needed; developmental timing of acute versus constitutive loss.
what_it_separates: Isoform-specific attribution control: lithium and each inhibitor repeated after knock-down.
what_it_does_not_separate: Protein level and compensation must be read; no WWOX or neuronal burst datum.

comparator: PI4K2A shRNA with shRNA-resistant wild type and S9/51A constructs
target_and_action: Genetic tool testing one GSK3 substrate branch (PI4KIIalpha) for NMDAR current; S9/51A are PI4KIIalpha residues, not GSK3 Ser9.
context_of_the_measurement: Rat organotypic CA1: knock-down halves the isolated NMDAR EPSC; wild-type rescue full; S9/51A none; AMPA current unchanged; LTD intact; efficiency and expression not shown in the text read.
selectivity_limits: Genetic, not a drug; the only branch-selective tool found; a small-molecule PI4KIIalpha inhibitor is named only in an abstract, identity and selectivity not read.
what_it_separates: Whether the GSK3-to-NMDAR-current branch (rather than the Wnt or tau branch) carries a drug effect.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not tell which GSK3 isoform carries the branch; no WWOX system.

comparator: d-APV, matched-current control (carried from the NMDA package)
target_and_action: Competitive NMDAR antagonist.
context_of_the_measurement: Carried from the NMDA package: bursts removed at 50 micromolar in Wwox neuron-knockout slices.
selectivity_limits: As in INV-05.
what_it_separates: What plain suppression of NMDAR current does to bursts at matched current, so a GSK3-route burst reduction can be told from current reduction.
what_it_does_not_separate: Says nothing about GSK3 identity or isoform.

target_and_action: GABA transaminase (ABAT) inactivator (target as stated in the need).
context_of_the_measurement: Human WWOX-DEE case reports, infancy to early childhood; counts only; co-therapy in every case; developmental statements are clinician narratives without a scale. 5 children with both endpoints in 4 reports (4 discordant: partial or transient improvement, no developmental progress recorded; 1 concordant non-response); the 2024 case is uninstrumented and the stall starts at spasm onset, before the drug. Home-observed freedom while video-EEG still recorded events.
selectivity_limits: Not independent of the other classes (three of the five also supply them; all five on co-therapy); symptom response is not a sustained, instrumented response.
exposure_or_development_note: Brain-imaging safety signal recorded beside them in two children (abstract level, report selected for the finding), not a frequency; population rate 18 of 64 imaged vigabatrin-treated children of mixed aetiology; no indication to exclude or change a therapy.
what_it_separates: Symptomatic response and developmental outcome as separate columns (the separation itself is the investigation).
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not show a developmental gain after response (none recorded); does not show development is unaffected by seizure control; course without the drug unknown.

target_and_action: NOT_IN_FILES (target not stated; class named as 'hormonal therapy' and 'ACTH/corticosteroid/phenobarbital regimens').
context_of_the_measurement: Human WWOX-DEE case reports, infancy to early childhood; counts only; co-therapy in every case; developmental statements are clinician narratives without a scale. Of those exposed, 3 of 11 have both endpoints (counts only, fewer than 5 branch). Clinician-reported control in heterogeneous curated reports; no genotype stratification, no comparator.
selectivity_limits: West syndrome frequent in the cohort, so a WWOX-genotype effect cannot be separated.
exposure_or_development_note: Counts not computable as a rate at n below 10.
what_it_separates: Contributes to the 36 to 38 exposed children across four classes; symptomatic and developmental endpoints kept apart.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not give an attributable outcome per class; not the WOREE population nor all antiseizure drugs.

target_and_action: Dietary therapy (not a drug); no target stated.
context_of_the_measurement: Human WWOX-DEE case reports, infancy to early childhood; counts only; co-therapy in every case; developmental statements are clinician narratives without a scale. Of those exposed, 2 of 12 have both endpoints. Five-patient series: clinician-reported improvement in 3 patients (two had died at the time of writing), no count, score or instrument on the delivered text surface; a response is also reported in 3 of 5 WOREE individuals in another file row.
selectivity_limits: Possible double counting of patient 4 among responders and patient 3 among exposed children across series; real-world continuation signal mixed (3 tried, 1 continued).
exposure_or_development_note: Developmental status a single label (profound developmental delay) in all five; no pre-diet status on the delivered surface.
what_it_separates: Symptomatic response recorded apart from development.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not show a developmental benefit; does not show allele dependence (the three responders carry splice-region or exon-deletion alleles).

target_and_action: Described as a T-type calcium channel blocker (see INV-03).
context_of_the_measurement: Mouse Wwox-null pups, one acute PTZ-provoked experiment; suppressed the PTZ seizure score in null pups (n 6 and 6); wild type floor-limited; nothing measured at the channel. Exposure in WWOX patients: reported for the class (question Q4), no attributable outcome.
selectivity_limits: See INV-03.
what_it_separates: Shows the existing-drug node is not only lithium; a provoked seizure score, not development or function.
what_it_does_not_separate: Does not separate T-type from non-selective action; a seizure score result says nothing about development, function or quality of life.

target_and_action: Ih (HCN) blocker; used as an ex vivo tool for sag, rebound and burst arms.
context_of_the_measurement: Rat DRG neurons (3-4 cells per concentration): sodium-current IC50 1.17 uM against HCN-current IC50 15 uM; recombinant Nav1.4 almost abolished at 30 uM; calcium channels only above 100 uM (cited). Mouse hippocampal cultures, 50 uM: removes sag and rebound, reports no T-current block (Supplementary, not read). A neocortical report cited in the WWOX paper: sag gone, Rin up, 4-AP events enhanced. No Wwox preparation exposed to an Ih blocker.
selectivity_limits: Sodium-channel block documented; 50 uM is about 40 times the 1.17 uM sodium-current IC50 and sodium current was not tested in the hippocampal paper (audit: do not rely on it); cortical Nav isoforms untested; potency depends on protocol, exposure time and access.
exposure_or_development_note: Poor brain penetration does not make the target useless ex vivo; no brain-exposure statement carried.
what_it_separates: Sag, resting potential, input resistance and burst incidence read in the same slices; branches A (compensatory), B (pro-excitatory) and C (bystander) give opposite signs.
what_it_does_not_separate: A sag removal is not proof that HCN carries the burst phenotype; a burst change is not HCN-specific without a second blocker and a sodium-current control.

target_and_action: HCN (Ih) blocker (the ranking row speaks of 'a clinically used HCN blocker'; identity as ivabradine stated only in the IT39 sentence).
context_of_the_measurement: Normal rat slices: blocks sag and hyperpolarises cortical L5 and L6 neurons; injection into somatosensory cortex cut absence-seizure time by 96 percent against 40 percent in thalamic VB (abstract level); the GAERS authors read Ih as not an adaptive response to spike-wave discharges.
selectivity_limits: Cellular potency in a cortical pyramidal neuron and selectivity among HCN isoforms not assessed here.
exposure_or_development_note: No brain-exposure statement is carried for any clinically used member.
what_it_separates: Functional precedent for cortical Ih block with a seizure-time readout in another model.
what_it_does_not_separate: Not a Wwox datum; does not give the sign in Wwox-deficient slices.

target_and_action: Separates a T-type rebound bump from Ih sag in the same cell.
context_of_the_measurement: Mouse hippocampal cultures, 0.5 mM: removed the post-inhibitory bump, sag largely intact.
selectivity_limits: Not shown selective among Cav3 subunits or against other targets in the passages read.
what_it_separates: T-type rebound component from Ih sag.
what_it_does_not_separate: Not an isoform assignment.

context_of_the_measurement: Reused from the T-type package; not re-read.
selectivity_limits: See INV-03 row; audit: not re-read here.

what_it_does_not_separate: No combination arm is added here; Cav3 class only.

comparator: XE991 and a Kv7 opener (existing lead)
target_and_action: Kv7 / M-current arm kept separate; tells Kv7 from other leak.
context_of_the_measurement: Reused from the IT13/IT14 packages; not re-read; the report mentioned in the brief was not available.
selectivity_limits: XE991-sensitive current is not all leak; opener recovery can be compensation for another defect.
what_it_separates: Branch D: loss of a resting potassium conductance as a rival to larger Ih (higher input resistance in both mutants).
what_it_does_not_separate: A Kv7-opener recovery does not prove a Kv7 lesion.

comparator: myr-22 decoy peptide with scrambled control
target_and_action: Trafficking tool: uncouples HCN1 from filamin A.
context_of_the_measurement: Cultured rat hippocampal neurons: raised Ih density and sag ratio; scrambled peptide and naive neurons did not differ; one laboratory; electrophysiology after a preincubation of over 30 minutes (audit correction of 'acute 4 h'); WWOX not involved in any passage read.
selectivity_limits: Not evidence that WWOX acts through filamin A.
what_it_separates: Surface or distribution change in HCN1 as an origin of the sag difference (hypothesis HY3), read only if X2/X6 point there.
what_it_does_not_separate: Not a treatment for Wwox slices; use only if surface or distribution is indicated.
